scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships

scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships

scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships
scholarships.description: Türkiye Scholarships offers various long-term bachelor's, master's, and PhD scholarships, as well as short-term research and merit-based scholarships, and joint scholarship programs for international students.

scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships – Sabancı University PURE Summer Research Program 2026
scholarships.description: A 7-week summer research program providing outstanding undergraduate students with a research experience at Sabancı University, including a monthly stipend, travel, and accommodation.

scholarships.title: YTB – Islamic Development Bank (ISDB) Joint Scholarship Program 2026

The program aims to enable high-achieving students from IsDB member countries and Muslim communities living in other countries to receive education at internationally recognized standards at prestigious universities in Türkiye, focusing on fields aligned with Sustainable Development Goals.

scholarships.title: Türkiye Scholarships 2026
scholarships.description: Türkiye Scholarships is a government-funded, competitive scholarship program for international students to pursue full-time or short-term programs at universities in Türkiye. The scholarship includes financial support, tuition fee, accommodation, and health insurance.

scholarships.title: International Student Academy
scholarships.description: The International Student Academy is a set of programs (Seminar, Specialization, Culture and Art, and Online Programs) aimed at strengthening the academic, social and cultural lives of international students studying at higher education institutions in Türkiye.

scholarships.title: International Student Academy
scholarships.description: The International Student Academy is a set of programs aimed at strengthening the academic, social, and cultural lives of international students in Türkiye, consisting of Seminar Programs, Specialization Programs, Cultural and Art Programs, and Online Programs.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships help build prosperity, security, and sustainable growth in partner countries and provide opportunities for undergraduate and postgraduate study, as well as short-term training.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide international students the opportunity to gain a globally recognised education in New Zealand. The scholarship covers full academic studies and includes support for personal development, leadership skills, and community contribution.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Full tertiary scholarships for eligible international students from developing countries to study fulltime at a New Zealand or Pacific education institution.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme offers scholarships for international students from eligible regions and countries to undertake undergraduate and postgraduate study in New Zealand at universities or institutes of technology.

scholarships.title: Thematic Short Term Training Scholarships
scholarships.description: Short professional training courses for mid and senior level professionals from eligible countries to build knowledge and skills in various sectors, sharing New Zealand's expertise.

scholarships.title: Vocational Short Term Training Scholarships
scholarships.description: The New Zealand Government offers Vocational Short Term Training Scholarships to fund skills training and work experience for professionals from eligible countries. Successful applicants undertake a training course with a New Zealand certified training provider, a work placement, or participate in an online or in-country training course.

scholarships.title: English Language Training for Officials Scholarships
scholarships.description: The New Zealand Government offers scholarships to government officials from eligible African and Asian countries to come to New Zealand for English language training. The program is designed for officials to improve their English and build professional links.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship Programme provides funding for citizens from eligible Pacific and Asian countries to study at tertiary education institutes in New Zealand or the Pacific.

scholarships.title: Samoa Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Samoa Foundation Scholarship provides funding for study in New Zealand. Applications open 4 August 2026 and close 4 September 2026.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships are government-funded opportunities for citizens from eligible developing countries to study in New Zealand or at specific regional universities in the Pacific. The scholarships are designed to help scholars contribute to the social and economic development of their home countries.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide opportunities for international students from eligible countries to undertake undergraduate and postgraduate study in New Zealand. The selection process is highly competitive and involves screening, psychometric testing, assessment of academic and work experience, and online video interviews. Scholars are expected to return to their home countries for at least two years after completing their studies to contribute to social and economic development.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide funding for students from eligible regions and countries to study in New Zealand. Applicants are encouraged to select subjects based on the social and economic needs of their home country.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship provides funding for international students from eligible countries to undertake undergraduate or postgraduate study in New Zealand. This page outlines the administrative process for individuals who have been selected as preferred candidates, including admission requirements and scholarship acceptance procedures.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships
scholarships.description: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarships provide funding for undergraduate and postgraduate study at approved education institutions in New Zealand and specific universities in the Pacific. The scholarships are available to citizens from eligible regions and countries, with a focus on subjects aligned with the social and economic needs of the applicant's country.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Manaaki New Zealand Scholarship provides funding for international students to study in New Zealand. It covers full tuition fees, living allowances, establishment costs, medical insurance, and travel. Recipients must meet specific academic and conduct requirements and follow scholarship policies.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) - Japanese Nationals
scholarships.description: The JJ/WBGSP provides scholarships for Japanese mid-career professionals dedicated to the alleviation of poverty and enhanced shared prosperity in developing countries, who are pursuing graduate degree programs outside of Japan in development-related fields.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships.provider: Government of Japan and The World Bank
scholarships.description: The Joint Japan/World Bank Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) was set up by the government of Japan in partnership with the World Bank to support the poorest countries in their endeavors to enhance the expertise and skill levels of aspiring practitioners and leaders, to contribute to policy reform for economic growth and social development.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships.description: The Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) empowers professionals from developing countries and from Japan to pursue graduate studies at leading universities around the world.

scholarships.title: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
scholarships.description: Since 1987, JJ/WBGSP has enabled more than 7,000 mid-career professionals from 160 developing countries and Japan to complete graduate degrees in development-related fields. The program is funded by the Government of Japan.

scholarships.title: Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program
